en: Hm. Is there really no tailor in Gensokyo that could make my daughter a suit?
Seems to be for some important event too... She was lamenting about it being torn.
Hecatia's wardrobe isn't exactly helping either.
Well then, there is one person left that I could ask...
My? What business do you seek here?
Do you not hate us Lunarians? I heard of the stories.
That is for later. I just need something from you.
"Help me, Eirin," you say? I get asked for help a lot, you know.
What are you in need of? All my medicine are tailor-made, for your information.
I'm a spirit. Do you think I look sick?
In the head, sure.
Okay, now.
Look, all I wanted to know is if you know any place to tailor a suit.
Eh? For whom?
For Reisen.
Ah, so you are the one who she has been staying with recently
Surprising, coming from you.
Yet my care for her are more tailored to her than you ever did.
Wow, okay.
Well, anyways, the suit is made in the Lunar Capital. Gensokyo does not really have this type of fashion.
I was afraid that it had to come to that. Oh well.
That's the person I was talking about.
Eh? Visitors? What are you doing here~?
What are *you* doing here? Is this not Doremy's place?
She went on vacation.
Look, I just need to get to the Lunar Capital.
(Also, is this not her place?)
Since you come to our place, you must play with us first~
Yea- wait what.
That's a whole vengeful spirit that is NOT a human we're dealing with.
Whatever, lets just get this over with.
Wahh... what was that for? I just said playing not actual fighting...
That danmaku is made for killing a person!
Yes, that is what I call it.
Now will you let me pass? I need to get a tailor as soon as possible.
A tailor...? Do you need something tailor-made?
Dreams are tailor-made to each person's mind too, you know.
I am a tailored maid if that counts
Good grief, I am leaving.
Huh? What are you doing here alone?
Are you back for more? Are you not tired of this?
Oh, you.
We leave our grudges aside for now. I have something to ask of you.
I need a tailor from the Lunar Capital.
Huhhhhh. Sure.
I am genuine.
You telling me, someone who attacked for- how many times? Is just here asking me to get a tailor.
Let's just cut to the chase. Hecatia is with you right?
She's busy in hell running a... fashion shop.
Riiiight. Sure.
I'm giving you a chance to leave. I am enjoying a vacation right now, you know.
I sometimes sneak out just to take my mind off the bureaucracy. My sister doesn't really like that.
You mean that vacation of imprisoning a half-god to run that "Ay Ai" whatever she called it?.
Look, I'm just doing whatever is necessary, okay?
Let's just get this over with.
Your attacks are much more defensive. What's up with that?
Are you feeling guilty?
Guilty? Don't be silly.
Actions don't lie. You got something in your mind.
It's probably related to the recent incident isn't it.
What do you even know about it? You're not there.
Are you here for technology this entire time? A technology that can be tailored to the preference of any user?
No, a suit tailor. For Reisen. It's getting a bit of wear and tear.
Oh, her. I used to-
I know. I know. You are a terrible owner.
See here, you are here staring at Earth longingly every night.
Do you feel that, sometimes, maybe that Gensokyo just had something that you miss?
That impure place? You think I want anything to do with that?
Do you not ever feel bored? To live on a clean slate for thousands of years?
You leave the capital every so often. You now even styled a mobcap; not exactly common there. I can feel that you are soul searching.
You know, the residents of Gensokyo may seem like a patchwork of different species and beliefs, but they're all cut from the same cloth
It's the variety that makes the spice of life. Despite the difference, they live in harmony with their own little tailored space. Isn't that more colorful?
What's up with this random lecture? You never ran a city, your opinion is useless to me.
Look, I'll get a tailor to sew up a new blazer. I already got Reisen's measurement. Please, just leave.
Whatever, not my problem anyways. Just get the suit ready soon.
(I guess this is it. Was not expecting to be lecturing a lunarian of all people.)
(God, the way that shrine maiden speaks is rubbing off on me.)
3 days later...

Eirin: Junko, there is a package labeled for you. It's from Toyohime.\nIt had to pass through a couple of people, because they can't exactly just come here.\nJunko: Right, I forgot to consider the logistics of that. At least it's here in time.
Eirin: What did you say for her to even agree to this?\nJunko: She did it under her own volition.\nEirin: Okayyyy... Sure?
Back at home somewhere...
Reisen: You got this suit just for me? Is the suit not from the Lunar Capital?\nHow did you even get your hand on this?
Junko: Let's just say... I did some negotiations.\nIt seemed important to you, so I thought I should do something about it.
Reisen: ...Thank you...\nI'll cherish this forever, you're the best!!!
Perhaps... a mother's love is what is truly tailor made.
